mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS at or below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates, producing statistically significant positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to lower cost of capital for future cash flows.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 102 indicates weakening industrial activity, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as economic contraction fears dominate equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 102 instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market strength, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns in <40% of PAYEMS > 142000 and UNRATE < 5.1 instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, RSAFS above 440,000 correlates with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to sustained consumer demand momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in >50% of late-cycle instances with RSAFS > 440000.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO monthly growth exceeding 0.5% forecasts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns, reflecting accelerating industrial production and economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO MoM > 0.5% instances.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1,125 units signals housing market strength, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns through immediate consumer spending and construction sector activity.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative in >50% of HOUST > 1125 instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly decline exceeding 0.1% indicates disinflation, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as bond yields fall and equity valuations expand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in >50% of CPIAUCSL MoM < -0.1% instances.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS > 440,000 combined with FEDFUNDS < 0.2% indicates strong consumer demand under accommodative monetary policy, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns in <40% of RSAFS > 440000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2% instances.
